integrity: All definitions and edge-boundary conditions are explicit; a direct Hall argument proves every balanced selection of size at least four remains feasible, and inclusion-exclusion counts matching witnesses. An independent exhaustive program checks the exact adjacency definition, every coefficient, and each matching count.
scientific_limitations: Graph family K_{m,n} with an arbitrary matching deleted, with both side sizes at least two.
The full paired-domination polynomial counts vertex sets; a separate pairing-weighted polynomial counts induced perfect matchings.
The crown-graph scalar paired-domination number four is previously known and is not claimed as new.
The verifier exhausts side orders at most six; the general result follows from Hall’s theorem and inclusion-exclusion.
A 2016 generic paired-domination-polynomial conference contribution was accessible only as a one-page abstract; no complete graph-family list was available.
title: Paired-domination resilience and matching counts under bipartite matching deletion
